query:
SELECT 
  WEEK(startTime, 1) as weekNum,
  MIN(DATE(startTime)) as weekStart,
  MAX(DATE(startTime)) as weekEnd,
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status != 'rescheduled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as nonRescheduled
FROM appointments 
WHERE therapistUserId = 4620148
AND startTime >= '2026-06-01'
AND startTime < '2026-07-01'
GROUP BY WEEK(startTime, 1)
ORDER BY weekNum;
